positive_snippets: Rooms are clean and comfortable but not the sound proof, also do not include breakfast in your package as they don't have facilities of serving hot food or in room breakfast. Better you order or use Swiggy/Zomato.
We had a really great time, the stay was good, and the staff was calm, and kind.
negative_snippets:
I had a very disappointing experience at Star Suits Hotel. We had booked a room expecting basic hospitality and flexibility, but the rules here are extremely unreasonable. Our teammates only came to visit us for about 5 minutes, and the hotel staff did not allow them to come up to the room at all.
What makes it worse is that this rule was never mentioned at the time of booking. If such strict policies exist, they should clearly inform guests in advance so people can decide accordingly.
The staff was not cooperative and showed no understanding of the situation. Overall, the experience felt very restrictive and unwelcoming.
I would not recommend staying here if you expect normal guest policies and transparent communication. ⭐ 1/5

Booked one room for 11-12 Oct and had very bad experience. Staff most discourteous especially suiting at reception. Despite repeated requests no water bottle made available in room. No tea made available. Even dinner was also denied on plea that we should take dinner outside.
On lodging a complaint even manager didn’t turn up to make some resolution. They have given us feel as if we are under a punishment while staying in Star Suites Hotel. In morning also it took me half an hour to take out my car due to haphazard and unplanned parking.
It is my humble suggestion to all never go to such a rubbish hotel.

Absolutely terrible experience! This is our second day here and the housekeeping is a complete failure. We switched on the ‘Clean My Room’ button before leaving in the morning, but when we came back NOTHING was done. No cleaning, no fresh towels, no water bottles – nothing! This is the most basic service a hotel should provide, and they couldn’t even manage that. Totally unacceptable and a waste of money. Never staying here again and would not recommend this hotel to anyone!
